title: weight-loading-optimization
summary: Optimize the serving-level weight load path from storage to device: judge the load path on four dimensions (source, format, placement, duplication), account startup fixed overhead separately from per-request cost with bytes-and-counts lines and hit-criteria warmup validation, verify sharded weight downloads against the safetensors index, apply device-side weight prefetch only on profiled memory-bound hot spots, and order CPU-tier offload candidates by change surface. Includes source-scoped disk-loading modes, pinned staging and synchronous checkpoint save semantics. Use when startup/loading latency dominates; route DCP asynchronous save performance and distributed recovery validity to their separate skills.
